definition: The cardinal number equal to nine tens; 90.

definition: The part projecting above the mouth on the face of a person, used for breathing and smelling.

definition: The eleventh month of the year, containing thirty days.
example: Chilly winds blow across the countryside during brisk November mornings.

definition: A person trained to care for the sick or infirm, especially in a hospital.
example: The caring nurse checked the patient's temperature every two hours.
amharic: ነርስ / አስታማሚ (ህሙማንን በሆስፒታል የምትንከባከብ ባለሙያ)

definition: The tenth month of the year, containing thirty-one days.
example: Autumn leaves turn brilliant gold and brown throughout October.
amharic: ኦክቶበር / ጥቅምት (የጎርጎሮሳውያን የቀን አቆጣጠር አስረኛው ወር)

definition: The lowest cardinal number; 1.

definition: A loose-fitting pair of jacket and trousers or soft clothing worn in bed for sleeping.
example: Children put on comfortable pajamas before brushing their teeth at bedtime.

definition: Used to apologize, express regret, or show sympathy.
example: I am sorry for stepping on your foot.
amharic: ይቅርታ (ለስህተት ወይም ለጸጸት ይቅርታ መጠየቂያ)

definition: A polite expression of gratitude or appreciation.
example: Thank you very much for your kind assistance.
amharic: አመሰግናለሁ (ምስጋናን በትህትና መግለጫ)

definition: An informal expression of gratitude.
example: Thanks a lot for helping me carry these books.
amharic: አመሰግናለሁ (ቀለል ያለ የምስጋና ቃል)

definition: In, at, or to that place or position.
example: The public library is located over there across the municipal square.
amharic: እዚያ (ከተናጋሪው ራቅ ያለ ቦታ)

definition: To a higher degree than is desirable, permissible, or possible; in addition; also.
example: This winter overcoat is too expensive for my student budget.
amharic: በጣም / ከመጠን በላይ (ከሚገባው በላይ የሆነ፤ ወይም ደግሞ)

definition: On or to an upper floor of a building.
example: The children ran happily upstairs to play with their toys in the playroom.
amharic: ወደ ላይ ፎቅ (የህንጻው የላይኛው ወለል ላይ)

definition: Under normal conditions; generally; as a rule.
example: He usually drinks a cup of black coffee before walking to school.
amharic: በተለምዶ | አብዛኛውን ጊዜ (በአብዛኛው የሚከሰት የተለመደ ሁኔታ)

definition: Used to greet someone upon arrival or acknowledge thanks.
example: Welcome to our home; please make yourself comfortable.
amharic: እንኳን ደህና መጣህ / መጡ (የአቀባበል ሰላምታ)

definition: At what time; interrogative adverb.
example: When does the morning train depart from the central railway terminal?
amharic: መቼ? (ጊዜን ለመጠየቅ የሚያገለግል)

definition: In or to what place or position; interrogative adverb.
example: Where did you leave your apartment keys before going to work?
amharic: የት? (ቦታን ለመጠየቅ የሚያገለግል)

definition: For what reason or purpose; interrogative adverb.
example: Why did you choose to study agricultural engineering at college?
amharic: ለምን? (ምክንያትን ለመጠየቅ የሚያገለግል)

definition: Used to express affirmation, agreement, or confirmation.
example: Yes, I would like to join the study group.
amharic: አዎ (ስምምነትን ወይም እውነታን ማረጋገጫ)
